metrics.profile_summary: Senior marketing and account management professional with extensive experience in brand strategy and 360° digital campaign execution. Proven track record in driving revenue growth, managing high-value portfolios, and optimizing digital performance metrics.

experience.description: Manages 15+ diverse brands, driving 30% upsell growth and leading cross-functional teams for 360° campaign execution and AI-driven content production.
Led digital rollouts and performance optimization, achieving significant CTR and CPA improvements while conducting competitive audits and market analysis.
Launched premium product lines, managed 150+ global KOLs, and executed high-ROAS digital campaigns and BTL activities.

strengths: Extensive experience in digital strategy and campaign management
Proven ability to handle high-value accounts and diverse portfolios
Strong analytical skills with a focus on ROI and ROAS
Experience with competitive research and market analysis
weaknesses: Potentially overqualified for a Specialist-level role
No explicit mention of Canva or Meta Business Suite
evaluation.summary: The candidate is an exceptional match who exceeds all minimum requirements. While their seniority (Associate Account Director) suggests they are overqualified for a basic Specialist role, their technical proficiency in digital marketing and strategy is superior.
